fusions.name: Doppler Shriek
fusions.desc: A shriek through a cone 5 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores resistances. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Swoop and Sip
fusions.desc: You dart up to 7 tiles to the target and bite it. The bite deals 12 damage, heals you for 30% of it and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Jinking Flutter
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Heard It Coming
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
